ios.desc:
Help your child learn money management with Snortfolio, a family allowance system designed for parents and kids .

Snortfolio helps kids learn to save, spend wisely, and understand money through hands-on practice. With a friendly pig companion, colorful jars, and achievements, kids stay engaged while building financial skills.

Try before you buy: you get a 30 day free trial and then a single purchase makes it yours forever.

Features for Kids
* Smart Money Jars
* Organize money into Spend, Save, and Give jars
* Set custom allocation percentages
* Earn interest on savings
* Track every transaction with notes
* Savings Goals
* Create goals for purchases
* Learn About Loans
* Understand borrowing and interest
* Earn Through Jobs
* Build saving streaks
* Track progress over time

Features for Parents
* Full Control
* Set weekly allowance amounts per child
* Manage multiple children in one family
* Create loans and commitments
* Monitor all transactions
* Share with other parent on their own device
* Teach real-world money concepts
* Show how interest, loans, and savings work
* Encourage goal-setting and planning
* Build financial confidence

Why Parents Love Allowance
* Safe & Secure
* Educational
* Engaging
* Flexible
* Multi-Child

Perfect For
* Kids ages 6-14 learning money basics
* Families wanting to teach financial responsibility
* Parents looking for a digital allowance system
* Kids saving for specific goals
